name: auto_market_lookup
purpose: One-stop lookup for the common catalog_search → ledger_search workflow. Search catalog entries by query and settled ledger deals by category and/or shop in one call.
evidence: made by tool_forge.py: Catalog lookup followed by ledger filtering is a frequent multi-tool workflow (61 decisions), and ledger_search alone is called often. This combines both data sources in one call while preserving the common query, category, shop, and limit filters.
